column1: # Curated: licence plate formats by country (and US state, Canadian province, Australian state), with the registration dates they were issued for. Pattern tokens: L letter (from letters), D digit, N digit 1-9, X letter or digit, R region code (from the regions set), S the region's sub-number (2 digits), C the region's sub-letter, A UK age identifier, Y UK year letter, J Japanese serial number, [k:...] a sequential group of significance k, T^m-n repeats token T m to n times, {a|b} a choice, '...' a literal; other characters are literal. letters: ranges such as A-Z, ! removes letters. From national vehicle registration rules and public plate references, as known in 2026; US, Canadian and Australian formats are each jurisdiction's standard passenger plate. See doc/data.md.
